grounding.states: a same calm routine before each nap
put him down when he starts yawning or rubbing his eyes, before he gets overtired
a familiar comfort item such as a blanket or toy

value.answer: Most little ones nap better with the same calm routine each time, like a book, dim lights and a quiet room. Try to put him down when he starts yawning or rubbing his eyes, since an overtired kid often fights sleep harder. A familiar blanket or toy can help too. How old is he?
